Question 14

The circle above is centered at C(−4,−3) and the point X(−1,0) lies on the circumference. Find the equation of the circle.

a
(x−4)2+(y−3)2=32
b
(x+4)2+(y−3)2=18
c
(x−4)2+(y−3)2=18
d
(x+4)2+(y+3)2=32
e
(x+4)2+(y+3)2=18
